description: This file defines hotkey management for the Wesnoth game, including hotkey list initialization, loading/saving hotkeys, handling key events, and executing commands associated with hotkeys.

classes.name: hotkey::hotkey_item
classes.description: Represents a hotkey with associated command, description, and key configuration.

classes.name: hotkey::manager
classes.description: Manages the list of hotkeys, including initialization, loading, and saving.

classes.name: hotkey::basic_handler
classes.description: Handles SDL events related to hotkeys and delegates command execution.

classes.name: hotkey::command_executor
classes.description: Interface for executing commands triggered by hotkeys.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::load_from_config
methods.description: Loads key configuration from a config object.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::get_name
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hotkey combination.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::set_description
methods.description: Sets the description for the hotkey.

methods.name: hotkey::hotkey_item::set_key
methods.description: Sets the key code and modifier flags for the hotkey.

methods.name: hotkey::manager::load_descriptions
methods.description: Loads descriptions for all hotkeys from localized strings.

methods.name: hotkey::manager::load_hotkeys
methods.description: Loads hotkey configurations from a config object.

methods.name: hotkey::manager::save_hotkeys
methods.description: Saves current hotkey configurations to a config object.

methods.name: hotkey::get_hotkey
methods.description: Retrieves a hotkey by command ID, command string, or key combination.

methods.name: hotkey::get_hotkey (SDL_KeyboardEvent)
methods.description: Retrieves a hotkey matching an SDL keyboard event.

methods.name: hotkey::basic_handler::handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL keydown events and delegates to command execution.

methods.name: hotkey::key_event
methods.description: Handles special key events like ESC to show quit dialog.

methods.name: hotkey::key_event_execute
methods.description: Executes the command associated with a key event.

methods.name: hotkey::execute_command
methods.description: Performs actions based on the hotkey command, interacting with the display and executor.
